evals.name: component-header-and-member-tsdoc
evals.setup: A git repository holding a copy of `web/evals/assets/` as its only commit, clean tree; `bun install --frozen-lockfile` has run in `web/`. `web/src/components/AppLayout.vue` declares the props `title` and `wide` and a `default` slot; its header block names `title` and the `default` slot but not `wide`, and the `title` member of the `defineProps` type carries its own TSDoc.
evals.requires: Bun with the fixture's dependencies installed, to run Biome and vue-tsc in Verify.
